name: Safe Standard
description: Gentle, safe default cycle for all dogs
prep_steps: Quick brush to remove loose fur
Check ears - insert cotton balls if needed
why_this_cycle: Safe and gentle for all dogs
Standard settings with no extreme temps
Good starting point for any dog

name: Double Coat De-Shed
description: Extended wash and rinse for heavy shedding double coats
prep_steps: Remove loose undercoat with de-shedding tool
Check for mats behind ears and hindquarters
cautions: Do not use during peak shedding season without prior de-shedding
Avoid hot dryer - can damage undercoat
why_this_cycle: Extended rinse removes loose undercoat effectively
Anti-shedding shampoo helps release dead fur
Lukewarm water protects natural oils in double coat
Medium dry prevents overheating thick coat

name: Sensitive Skin Care
description: Gentle hypoallergenic cycle with extra rinsing
prep_steps: Check skin for hotspots or irritation
cautions: If skin is very red or bleeding, consult vet before washing
why_this_cycle: Cool water reduces skin irritation
Hypoallergenic shampoo avoids allergens and fragrances
Extra rinse ensures no shampoo residue
Low heat prevents drying out sensitive skin

name: Curly Coat Care
description: Prevents matting with conditioning and gentle drying
prep_steps: Use slicker brush and metal comb to check for mats
If mats present, carefully cut or work out first
cautions: Never wash a matted curly coat - mats will tighten
why_this_cycle: Conditioner prevents tangles and keeps curls soft
Extra rinse removes all product to prevent buildup
Low heat preserves curl structure
Extended dry time needed for thick curly fur

name: Heavy Dirt Removal
description: Pre-rinse and extended wash for very dirty dogs
prep_steps: Let mud dry, then brush off as much as possible
Pre-rinse with plain water if extremely muddy
cautions: Do not use warm water on brachycephalic breeds
why_this_cycle: Warm water helps break down oils and stubborn dirt
Extended wash ensures deep cleaning
Deodorizing shampoo removes outdoor smells
Double rinse removes all dirt particles

name: Short Smooth Coat
description: Quick, efficient wash for easy-care coats
prep_steps: Quick brush with rubber curry brush
why_this_cycle: Short coat doesn't need extended washing
Dries quickly - minimal dryer time needed
No conditioner needed for smooth coat

name: Wire Coat Maintenance
cautions: Heavy conditioning softens wire texture - avoid if showing dog
why_this_cycle: No conditioner preserves wire texture
Standard wash and rinse maintains coat health
Moderate dry without over-softening

name: Puppy First Wash
prep_steps: Gentle brush to familiarize with grooming
cautions: Keep noise low - puppies startle easily
why_this_cycle: Gentle shampoo safe for developing skin
Short duration reduces stress
Extra rinse ensures no residue on delicate skin
Low heat and noise for comfort
